# Style 06 · Bold Editorial

> Every page is a cover.

**Keywords:** Opinionated · Dramatic · Cultured · Sharp · Narrative  
**Mood:** Editorial · Bold · Premium  
**Sectors:** Media, arts & culture · Luxury & fashion · Education & public sector  
**Strongest applications:** Print & editorial · Social media · Advertising · Websites · Presentations

> **Fictional sample brand.** The Margin, culture and fashion magazine, and every person, figure and address in its examples are invented to demonstrate this style. This is not client work. Domains use the reserved `.example` TLD.

## Concept

Bold Editorial borrows from fashion magazines and newspaper covers. Oversized high-contrast serif headlines, dramatic scale changes, column structure and full-bleed imagery give the brand a strong voice and an opinion.

## Target industries

- Media and publishing
- Fashion and luxury retail campaigns
- Museums, galleries and culture
- Film, music and events
- Personal brands and thought leaders

## Color palette

| Name | Hex | Role | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Paper | `#FAFAF7` | Background | 55% |
| Ink | `#0E0E0E` | Headlines, body, reversed sections | 30% |
| Stone | `#D9D4CC` | Panels, image placeholders | 6% |
| Slate | `#4A4A48` | Secondary text, captions | 5% |
| Edition Red | `#C8102E` | Kickers, issue numbers, one highlight | 4% |

**Rule:** Mostly black and white. Edition Red marks the kicker, the issue number or one word.

## Typography

| Role | Family | Weights | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | **Bodoni Moda** | 400, 700 · italic | Cover lines, headlines, drop caps |
| Body | **Libre Franklin** | 400, 600, 800 | Body, kickers, captions |
| Arabic | **Amiri (display) · Noto Kufi Arabic (kickers)** | | High-contrast Naskh for headlines and a sturdy Kufi for small kickers mirrors the serif/grotesk split. |

**Type scale** (desktop, px size / line height)

| Level | Size | Weight | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cover | 120 / 104 | 400 | Tight leading, mixes roman and italic |
| H1 | 56 / 60 | 700 | -2% tracking |
| Kicker | 12 / 16 | 800 | Franklin uppercase, +12% tracking, red |
| Body | 17 / 27 | 400 | Two or three columns in print |
| Caption | 12 / 17 | 400 | Slate, italic for credits |

- Use extreme scale contrast: the headline is 6–8× the body size.
- Mix roman and italic in one headline for rhythm.
- Open long reads with a three-line drop cap.

## Layout rules

- **Grid:** 6 or 12 columns · 20px gutter · column rules between text columns
- **Spacing:** 8px base. Tight within groups, dramatic between them.
- **Corners:** 0.

- Headlines may run over images and bleed off the edge.
- Use full-bleed imagery for openers.
- Separate columns with 1px vertical rules.
- Put a masthead or kicker line at the top of every layout.
- Use pull quotes at display size to break long text.

## Photography direction

Fashion-editorial portraits with strong direction and dramatic light.

- Direct-to-camera portraits with attitude.
- Strong directional light, deep shadows.
- Both high-key and low-key are allowed, but commit to one per story.
- Crop boldly: cut through faces, extreme close-ups.
- Black-and-white for features and colour for fashion.

**Sample shot list**

1. Portrait, hard side light, direct gaze (grade: `#BDB6AC` → `#5A5550` → `#0E0E0E`)
2. Extreme close-up crop, red lip (grade: `#E2D6CC` → `#C8102E` → `#2A1A1A`)
3. Full-length look on seamless grey (grade: `#D9D4CC` → `#9A948C` → `#3A3836`)

**Avoid**

- Smiling stock portraits
- Flat, even lighting
- Busy backgrounds behind the subject

## Graphic elements

- Masthead and issue numbering
- Column rules and thick top bars
- Drop caps and pull quotes
- Red kicker labels
- Headline type overlapping imagery

## UI examples

- Buttons are black rectangles with uppercase Franklin labels.
- Links underlined in red on hover.
- Article cards: image, red kicker, serif headline, byline.
- Section headers sit on a thick black top rule.

- Primary button: `Subscribe` · Secondary button: `Read the issue`
- Input: Your email: `reader@example.com`
- Tags: `Culture` `Interview` `8 min read`
- Card: **The return of slow fashion**, By Noor Haddad, Issue 27

## Social media examples

- Every post looks like a cover or a spread.
- Quote cards with huge serif quotation marks.
- Carousels read like turning pages.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Feed post 1080 × 1080 | Issue 27 · Interview | “Style is a decision.” |  |
| Story 1080 × 1920 | On newsstands | The Slow Issue | Read now |
| Feed ad 1080 × 1350 | Subscribe | Six issues. One point of view. | Subscribe |

## Website example

- The homepage reads like a front page: lead story plus columns.
- Article pages: large headline, drop cap, pull quotes, wide images.
- A sticky masthead with issue number.

- **Navigation:** Culture · Fashion · Ideas · Issues
- **Hero eyebrow:** Cover story
- **Hero headline:** The slow issue.
- **Hero copy:** Twelve designers on why they are making less, and why it is working.
- **Actions:** Read the story / All issues
- **Proof row:** Culture (The galleries rewriting the Gulf art map.) · Fashion (Inside the last tailoring house in Baghdad.) · Ideas (Why we stopped trusting algorithms.)

## Advertising campaign

**Campaign:** Have a Point of View

Cover lines from the current issue become the ads. Each one is a strong opinion in quotation marks.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Billboard 48-sheet (6096 × 3048 mm) | The Margin · Issue 27 | “Style is a decision.” | On newsstands now |
| Display MPU 300 × 250 and leaderboard 728 × 90 | | Six issues. One point of view. | Subscribe |

- Treat every ad like a cover: masthead, cover line, issue number.
- Book newsstand, metro and cultural-district sites.
- Animated banners turn like pages, two frames at most.

## Presentations

- **Cover slide:** Media kit 2027 · **The slow issue.** · Advertising partnerships · sample deck
- **Content slide:** Who reads The Margin. Key figure **48 min** (average time spent with each issue); points: Culture-led professionals, 28–45; Print and digital editions; Quarterly events in Dubai and Beirut. Figures are sample data.

- Slides look like spreads: kicker, headline, columns.
- Full-bleed portraits open each chapter.
- Use pull quotes at display size instead of bullet lists.

## Brand applications

Business card, letterhead and email signature for **Noor Haddad**, Editor-in-Chief (`noor@themargin.example`, fictional).

| Application | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Magazine cover | fixed masthead, cover lines change per issue |
| Tote bag | masthead in Bodoni, red issue number |
| Event invitation | black card, red kicker, serif headline |
| Newsletter | single column, drop cap, red kicker |

- The masthead is never recoloured except in Paper on Ink.
- Issue numbers are part of the identity system.
- Photography credits are always printed.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Be dramatic with scale | Small, timid headlines |
| Use real, specific headlines | Rounded corners |
| Let images bleed | Colourful UI accents |

## Design tokens

Text in the accent colour uses `--avdl-accent-text`, which passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) on both `bg` and `surface`.

```css
[data-style="bold-editorial"] {
  --avdl-bg: #FAFAF7;
  --avdl-surface: #F0EEE9;
  --avdl-ink: #0E0E0E;
  --avdl-muted: #4A4A48;
  --avdl-accent: #C8102E;
  --avdl-accent-text: #C8102E;
  --avdl-accent-2: #0E0E0E;
  --avdl-on-accent: #FFFFFF;
  --avdl-line: #0E0E0E;
  --avdl-font-display: 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, 'Bodoni 72', Georgia, serif;
  --avdl-font-body: 'Libre Franklin', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', Arial, sans-serif;
  --avdl-display-weight: 400;
  --avdl-display-case: none;
  --avdl-display-tracking: -0.02em;
  --avdl-radius: 0px;
  --avdl-button-radius: 0px;
  --avdl-border-width: 1px;
  --avdl-shadow: none;
  --avdl-color-paper: #FAFAF7;
  --avdl-color-ink: #0E0E0E;
  --avdl-color-stone: #D9D4CC;
  --avdl-color-slate: #4A4A48;
  --avdl-color-edition-red: #C8102E;
}
```
